implementation_sequence.work: Complete question-level portfolio planning across all provisional-ID agentic releases, retaining identity-only and inaccessible sources as explicit gaps.
Consolidate equivalent cross-benchmark questions and shared real-data prerequisites without merging distinct estimands or protocol requirements.
Review the full portfolio and priority order before assigning bounded implementation packets to subagents.
Implement connected tasks, validate native oracles and deterministic verifiers, then update measured coverage.

decision_constraints: Real observed biological inputs and documented sample/taxon/assay identity; no invented observations or benchmark fixtures/answers.

Harbor is the sole execution and evaluation protocol for authored tasks: terminal-based solving, pinned task environments, private executable oracles and deterministic artifact verifiers. Notebook-based source benchmarks inform scientific endpoints only; no notebook runner, submission protocol or protocol-parity requirement.
Offline solving and at most 30 minutes per task; scale realistic inputs on reserved remote CPU resources.
No LLM judge. Exact computations, tolerances, graph/subspace invariants, observed labels and held-out metrics require explicit per-task acceptance rules.
Do not automatically equate assay/protocol definitions, paper-level insights, or shared tool names with distinct completed workflows.
Keep generic method cards connected to a biological question. Open-ended planning or evidence judgments stay unresolved where an executable contract cannot preserve their scientific meaning.
Use one bounded worker; lead owns scientific design, independent-data suitability, ranking and coverage promotion.
